items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a much more highly respected professional player, because Shorty would be about – close to 10 years older than me. So naturally there was a big gap... I was already a professional, but his teacher, Buchanan, would always tell me... 'you got to hear this little Dewey Davis.'

ctx.x: I want to ask you about Shorty Baker. Did you know him in St. Louis?
Yeah. Did you know him? Were you aware of him in St. Louis?
